name: ripgrep
summary: AI is welcome as a coding tool with a human in the loop who understands the work; autonomous agents are not allowed. Comments, issues and PR bodies must be in your own words; quoted AI context must be disclosed, and AI editing or translation for non-native speakers is accepted.

evidence.quote: Using AI (i.e., LLMs) as tools for coding is welcome.
Autonomous agents are not allowed to be used for contributing to this project.
If you are opening an issue, you should be able to describe the problem in your own words.
AI should not be used to generate comments when communicating with maintainers.
If you wish to include context from an interaction with AI in your comments, it must be in a quote block (e.g., using `>`) and disclosed as such.
